KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. nene
   B. pana
   C. fupi
   D. zito

2. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.

3. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. kitoto
   B. mitoto
   C. mato
   D. watoto

4. When practising huyu na hawa, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” huyu na hawa.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to huyu na hawa.
   C. Copy random text without understanding huyu na hawa.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for huyu na hawa.

5. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   B. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   C. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   D. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.

6. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.

7. When practising asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa., which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..
   B. Use insults to “practise” asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..
   C. Avoid reading anything related to asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..

8. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.

9. When practising Kuzungumza:Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kuzungumza:Msamiati.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Kuzungumza:Msamiati.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Kuzungumza:Msamiati.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Kuzungumza:Msamiati.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

2. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.

3. D — watoto

4. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for huyu na hawa.

6. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.

7. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..
